goal: Use ordinary ChatGPT chat as the primary control plane for deep, durable, verifiable agent work while preserving existing capabilities and independently improving chat responsiveness and cross-chat coordination.

goalConfirmations.question: Is ordinary ChatGPT chat the primary user-facing control plane rather than Codex or Work?
Can long work continue in a durable external runtime without keeping the chat render loop busy?
Are local filesystem, terminal and browser actions routed only through an actually reachable authorized backend?
Are deep reasoning quality and UI responsiveness measured separately so speed never means shallow reasoning?
Can multiple chats discover the same task_ref and coordinate without overwriting each other?
Does every mutation bind actor, branch, base/head SHA, run identity and receipts?
Can interruption, cancellation and resume avoid duplicate non-idempotent side effects?
Are current June-August 2026 upstream options compared before replacing verified components?
Can chat lag be diagnosed as server/network, streaming, main-thread/render or chat-switch latency without capturing conversation text?
Is COMPLETE impossible until ten lanes, hard release gates and live ordinary-chat/local/browser E2E all agree?

observableOutcomes.ordinaryChat: submit/status/cancel/resume/receipt are available through a route exposed to ordinary chat
observableOutcomes.responsiveness: TTFT, maximum stream gap, long-animation-frame/long-task counts and chat-switch-to-paint latency are measurable
observableOutcomes.crossChat: same task_ref has one authoritative event chain and explicit handoff
observableOutcomes.closure: one integration SHA has all ten lane PASS evidence plus live E2E and enforced release checks
